item: A job holds its passphrase while it runs, so a library's log record is scrubbed of it too
key_paths: src/monitoring/secret_scrub.py src/backup/volume_job.py src/backup/import_queue.py src/backup/export_job.py tests/test_job_passphrase_held_r111.py tests/test_export_job.py
summary: SQLAlchemy's pool logged Exception during reset with exc_info while a backup failure was handled; the chained exception quoted the backup passphrase, which SecretFilter could not take out because the process did not hold it. secret_scrub.holding/held_during hold a job's passphrases for its life (volume backup, restore, verify; the import queue run; the export's corpus start; every scrub_and_reraise route block), so the filter on every handler scrubs any library's record. A secret under the scrub floor is not held process-wide. The backup and verify runs record a failure after its handler ended, from scrubbed texts. The shape cache is not written back for a hold that ended. test_export_job's passphrase test is deterministic and fails without the hold. Two security reads, no must-fix.
